candidates: docs/guides/templates/kc.adoc:53 - Documented command overrides the user's configured feature set with only `rolling-updates`.. This macro now adds a hard-coded `--features=rolling-updates` to every `update-compatibility` example. A CLI option takes precedence over `keycloak.conf` and env vars, so this flag replaces any `features` the deployment already sets instead of adding to them. A user who copies the example gets metadata or a check run for a feature set that differs from what the server actually runs, which can give a wrong rolling/recreate verdict. On an optimized image built with other features, it can also cause a build-option mismatch. The docs should tell users to add `rolling-updates` to their existing `--features` list (or to their config), not override the list with this single value.
